content.short: Zalathor Academy of Sorcery is a multilevel, story-driven & art-based CNFT project.
content.description:
Our main focus is to bring utility to our community, as well as top quality art. The project is developed on 3 different pillars:

1) The chronicle which is our lore and will be driven by our holders as we move on

2) Art: We have taken the hard path and created unique, photorealistic Sorcerers figures for our main collection and a 3D, animated limited sub-collection for our Book of Resurrection pass (sold-out)

3) Utility: We plan to have different kinds of utilities for our holders.

Customized tools & bots that will enable our holders to navigate the crypto & NFTs market more efficiently. We have already released 3 features: The floor movement & stats bot, Sentiment bot and Trending CNFTs. More will be added as we move forward.

Native token & staking mechanism that will be connected with the Magic Duels (more details will follow as the project unfolds)

Holders will get the chance to participate in NFTs raffles & auctions that the project keeps in the Vault (community wallet). They will also get to vote for our future investments in terms of new CNFT purchases.
